defensetea.name: Defense Tea
defensetea.desc: A robust tea brewed with coconut and tiger's eye. Boosts your defense.
lucktea.name: Luck Tea
lucktea.desc: A shimmering tea made from pomegranate and jade. Grants a bit of extra luck.
healingtea.name: Healing Tea
healingtea.desc: A soothing floral blend of blackberries and quartz. Great for restoring health.
farmingtea.name: Farming Tea
farmingtea.desc: An earthy brew of garlic and spring onions. Improves your farming focus.
miningtea.name: Mining Tea
miningtea.desc: A spicy kick of hot pepper and diamond. Helps you swing the pickaxe harder.
fishingtea.name: Fishing Tea
fishingtea.desc: A salty blend of seaweed and clam. Makes the fish bite more often.
attacktea.name: Attack Tea
attacktea.desc: A powerful infusion of ginger and obsidian. Increases your attack power.
speedtea.name: Speed Tea
speedtea.desc: A refreshing mix of carrot and mango. Gives you a burst of energy and speed.
grandmother.name: Grandmother Blackthorne
grandmother.dialogue.Introduction: Ah, there you are, @. I was wondering when the road would finally bring you to my hearth. Come in from the cold, child. $1
grandmother.dialogue.Mon: Mondays are for sweeping old dust out of corners. Houses remember grief if you let it sit too long. $0
grandmother.dialogue.Tue: Annette worries with her whole heart. If you see her rushing about, remind her that tea tastes better when one sits down to drink it. $1
grandmother.dialogue.Wed: Kira tried to steal a cookie from my table this morning. I let her think she was clever. $1
grandmother.dialogue.Thu: The village feels steadier today. Not healed, no, but willing. That is where healing starts. $0
grandmother.dialogue.Fri: If the inn is bright tonight, I may go sit by the fire and listen. A village needs stories almost as much as bread. $1
grandmother.dialogue.Sat: Saturday is a good day for mending. Socks, fences, tempers... all of them unravel if ignored. $0
grandmother.dialogue.Sun: Rest today if you can, @. Even brave souls grow thin when stretched over too many worries. $1
grandmother.dialogue.rain: Rain wakes the roots and quiets the restless. I have a pot on the stove if your bones are chilled. $1
grandmother.dialogue.GreenRain: Green rain... hm. Old forest breath. Do not fear it, but do not mock it either. Wild things have long memories. $2
grandmother.dialogue.spring_Mon: Spring always makes the earth talkative. If you listen closely, you can hear seeds arguing about who will sprout first. $1
grandmother.dialogue.summer_Wed: Summer heat makes magic impatient. Drink water before you cast spells or swing tools, child. $0
grandmother.dialogue.fall_Fri: Autumn is when the world tells the truth. What was grown, what was wasted, what must be stored for darker nights. $0
grandmother.dialogue.winter_Sun: Winter is not empty. It is a held breath. Treat it kindly and it will teach you patience. $1
grandmother.dialogue.AnnetteHouseInside: This house has become a meeting place for half the village. Good. A warm room should never keep its warmth to itself. $1
grandmother.dialogue.Moonvillage: Moon Village is awake, but still tender. Step softly where the stones hum under your boots. $0
grandmother.dialogue.HerbHouse: Lorilai's herbs know more than they admit. I only wish they would stop shedding leaves in my pockets. $1
grandmother.dialogue.OldMoonInn: The old inn has a fine hearth. A little too smoky, perhaps, but smoke keeps secrets well. $0
grandmother.dialogue.Hearts_2: You have kind hands, @. The valley notices such things, even when people forget to say them aloud. $1
grandmother.dialogue.Hearts_4: When you walk through Moon Village, the old roads settle. They trust you more than they used to. $0
grandmother.dialogue.Hearts_6: I have seen many helpers arrive with loud promises. You are quieter than that. Better, too. $1
grandmother.dialogue.Hearts_8: If the moon-gate ever frightens you, remember this: doors are only dangerous when no one remembers why they were built. $0
grandmother.dialogue.Hearts_10: You have become family to this place, @. Not by blood, perhaps, but blood is only one kind of binding. $1
grandmother.dialogue.AcceptGift_Loved: Oh, you remembered exactly the sort of thing I love. Bless your thoughtful heart. $1
grandmother.dialogue.AcceptGift_Liked: Thank you, child. This will be put to good use. $1
grandmother.dialogue.AcceptGift_Neutral: How kind of you. I appreciate the thought. $0
grandmother.dialogue.AcceptGift_Disliked: Mm. Not quite my taste, but I will not scold a generous hand. $2
grandmother.dialogue.AcceptGift_Hated: No, no. Take that away, please. Some things should not come into a warm house. $5
grandmother.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)223: Cookies? Now that is a proper gift. Sit down, and I will pretend I did not already have a tin hidden away. $1
grandmother.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)724: Maple syrup. Good medicine for bitter mornings and better manners alike. Thank you. $1
grandmother.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)Stard: Stardrop Tea... oh, child. This is a rare kindness. I will drink it slowly. $1
grandmother.dialogue.AcceptBirthdayGift_: For my birthday? You have warmed an old heart today. Thank you, @. $1
A birthday gift. How thoughtful. Come, let me make room for it by the hearth. $1
event.quest_reward_random_tea: You received a random magical tea.
message.magic_disturbance: The air grows still. For a moment, the trees seem to listen...
mail.mysterious_rumor: To the farmer...^There are places in the woods where old paths remember being walked. If you hear the leaves whisper after sundown, follow them carefully. Something forgotten is waking.^ - A Friend
event.secret_woods_anomaly: A pale shimmer passes between the trees. The old stones hum softly, as if answering a voice you cannot hear.
mail.wizard_invite: @,^The spirits near the Secret Woods have become unusually active. Their movement follows a pattern I have not seen since my earliest studies of this valley. Come to my tower. We must speak before the disturbance spreads.^  - M. Rasmodius
mail.wizard_quest_mail: Greetings @,^The disturbance in the woods has not faded. If anything, it has become more focused. Return to the clearing and look for signs of old forest script. Do not ignore any stones, circles, or unnatural silence.^  - M. Rasmodius
mail.wizard_guild_invite: Greetings @,^I have compared the markings you found with my oldest notes on forest spirits and sealed places. Marlon must hear this as well. Meet Annette and me at the Adventurer's Guild.^  - M. Rasmodius
mail.annette_party: Dear @,^Moon Village is awake again. The lanterns are lit, the old roads are warm, and our neighbors are finally laughing under the stars. Come to the village tonight. We want to thank you properly.^  - Annette
mail.annette_house_ready: Hello @,^The Townhall hearth is burning again. It feels less like an empty building now, and more like the village remembers us. Come visit when you have time.^  - Annette
mail.inn_ready: Hello @,^The Hidden Hearth has opened its doors again. The windows glow at night now, and for the first time in years, the road outside sounds alive.^  - Annette
mail.spirit_healer_ready: Greetings @,^The Spirit Healer's house is restored. The air around it feels calm now, like a held breath finally released. Thank you for helping us wake another piece of Moon Village.^  - Annette
mail.herbalist_ready: Hello @,^Celestial Remedies is ready. The old garden beds are sprouting again, and Lorilai says the roots remember where they belong.^  - Annette
mail.granary_ready: Hello @,^The Cosmic Corral is repaired. The fields feel warmer, and the animals no longer shy away from the old fence line. Your help means the world to Moon Village.^  - Annette
mail.grocery_ready: Hello @,^The Moon Glow Grocery Store is open again. It is only a small thing, maybe, but a village feels real when people can gather for bread, fruit, and gossip.^  - Annette
mail.lorilai_bedroom_ready: Hello @,^Lorilai has finally opened the little room above Celestial Remedies. She says the herbs there dried through the curse without losing their scent, which sounds impossible... but Moon Village has been full of impossible things lately.^  - Annette
quest.secret_woods_description: A strange presence stirs in the Secret Woods. It feels old, quiet, and almost familiar.
quest.secret_woods_objective: Enter the Secret Woods and investigate the disturbance.
quest.meet_wizard_description: The Wizard has sensed the same strange presence you found in the woods. He believes it may be tied to old forest magic.
quest.wizard_description: The Wizard believes the disturbance is tied to a sealed village hidden somewhere beyond the normal paths of the Secret Woods.
quest.wizard_objective: Return to the Secret Woods and search for old runes.
quest.guild_meeting_description: The Wizard has called a meeting at the Adventurer's Guild. Annette and Marlon will be there to discuss the strange magic around Moon Village.
quest.arcane_key_title: A Focus for the Old Path
quest.arcane_key_description: The Wizard needs simple but symbolically strong materials to steady the old Moon Village warp.
quest.arcane_key_objective: Bring the Wizard an Aquamarine, one Sap, and five Cave Carrots.
quest.arcane_key_complete: The Wizard binds the materials into a small rune focus. The air around the old path begins to hum, steady and low.
quest.reward_1000g_random_tea: 1,000g and a strange tea from the Wizard's stores
quest.hidden_maze_description: Annette believes monsters are gathering inside the old maze near Moon Village. The Wizard suspects the maze may be feeding on the broken seal.
quest.hidden_maze_objective: Find the hidden maze and stop the monsters from gathering.
mail.hidden_maze_quest: @,^I am sorry to ask more of you so soon, but something is moving beneath the old maze. The air tastes cold near the entrance, and Kira will not go near it. I fear the monsters are not wandering there by chance.^Please find the maze before whatever calls them grows stronger.^ - Annette
event.hidden_maze.annette_1: @... wait. Before you go, there is something I have avoided saying aloud.
event.hidden_maze.annette_2: Beyond the broken paths lies an old maze. It was built as part of the village's protection rites, long before the curse.
event.hidden_maze.annette_3: Now monsters gather inside it. If the maze is feeding the seal, then Moon Village will never truly wake unless it is stopped.
event.wizard_tower_1: Ah, @... good. The spirits near the Secret Woods have been restless for several nights.
event.wizard_tower_2: At first I thought it was Junimo activity, but the pattern is older. Colder. The markings you found belong to a sealed place.
event.wizard_tower_3: Stand still for a moment, farmer. Do you feel it? The air is thin here, as if the woods are holding their breath.
event.annette_intro_1: A stranger...? Stay back! Wait... you're warm. You're not part of the spell.
event.annette_intro_2: Forgive me. My thoughts are still tangled. I am Annette, Prefect of Moon Village... or what remains of it.
event.annette_intro_3: @... a farmer? Then the forest chose strangely. By crossing the old path, you broke a seal we believed would never open.
event.annette_intro_4: Tell me... does this valley still have someone who studies spirits, runes, and old magic?
event.annette_intro_5: Then I must find this Wizard. If the seal has opened, the village may finally have a chance to wake.
event.guild_meeting.wizard_1: Thank you for coming, @. What you found in the woods is not ordinary magic.
event.guild_meeting.marlon_1: I've tracked monsters for most of my life. Lately, their trails have all been bending toward the same place.
event.guild_meeting.wizard_2: Moon Village was mentioned in several old records, but I believed it was a local myth. A place hidden between forest paths.
event.guild_meeting.marlon_2: Old adventurers used to speak of it by the fire. A village that vanished without leaving ruins.
event.guild_meeting.annette_1: It did not vanish. It was sealed. My people are still there, caught between one moment and the next.
event.guild_meeting.marlon_3: Someone used powerful magic to lock the village away. Maybe to protect it. Maybe to punish it. Either way, the spell turned rotten.
event.guild_meeting.annette_2: It happened during the Moonlight Festival. The lanterns froze in the air. The music stopped. I spoke a counter-charm before the seal closed, but I could only leave a crack.
event.guild_meeting.marlon_4: And @ walked straight through that crack.
event.guild_meeting.wizard_3: The farmer carries Forest Magic. That may be why the seal recognized them instead of rejecting them.
event.guild_meeting.wizard_4: The source lies beyond Moon Village, deep in the Celestial Forest. If the village heart can be restored, the spell may weaken.
event.guild_meeting.annette_3: Please, @. Meet me in Moon Village when you're ready. I will show you what remains.
event.guild_meeting.wizard_5: Be cautious. Old magic rarely sleeps peacefully after being disturbed.
event.moonvillage_arrival.annette_1: Welcome to Moon Village, @. Please... step carefully. Some of these stones have not felt footsteps in years.
event.moonvillage_arrival.annette_2: The people you see are not statues. They are my neighbors, my friends... caught in the last breath before the spell closed.
event.moonvillage_arrival.annette_3: The old Townhall is the heart of our village. If its light returns, perhaps the others will begin to wake.
bundle.townhall.name: Moon Village Restoration
bundle.townhall.description: The heart of the village is cold and silent. Bring offerings of light, earth, and memory to wake the first old magic.
bundle.townhall.completed: Warm light returns to the Townhall. Somewhere nearby, an old door opens and a frozen breath is released.
bundle.annette_house.name: Townhall Hearth Offering
bundle.annette_house.desc: Restore warmth to Annette's home and steady the village heart.
bundle.spirit_healer.name: Spirit Healer Offering
bundle.spirit_healer.desc: Bring materials touched by life and light to restore the healer's house.
bundle.moon_grocery.name: Moon Glow Offering
bundle.moon_grocery.desc: Restore the village store so daily life can return to Moon Village.
bundle.herbalist.name: Celestial Remedies Offering
bundle.herbalist.desc: Bring herbs, stone, and forest gifts to wake the old remedy garden.
bundle.moon_inn.name: Hidden Hearth Offering
bundle.moon_inn.desc: Restore the inn's warm light so villagers may gather again.
bundle.moon_granary.name: Cosmic Corral Offering
bundle.moon_granary.desc: Restore the granary and bring life back to the village fields.
event.townhall_fixed.annette_1: @, you did it! Warmth is flowing through the Townhall again. Look... the frost on the old beams is melting.
event.townhall_fixed.lorilai_1: W-what happened? I heard the festival bell, then nothing... Annette? Why are the vines over the windows? Who is this stranger?
event.townhall_fixed.annette_2: It is a very long story, Lorilai. Moon Village was sealed, but this farmer has brought us our first spark of morning.
event.townhall_fixed.lorilai_2: Sealed...? Then the herbs must be wild by now. Thank you, stranger. If the plants survived, so can we.
event.grocery_first_visit.lorilai_1: Oh! @, welcome in. It still feels strange seeing the shelves standing straight again.
event.grocery_first_visit.lorilai_2: Annette says a village is not truly awake until people can trade, cook, argue over prices, and leave with full baskets.
event.grocery_first_visit.lorilai_3: I stocked what I could for now. If you need tea, food, or a little comfort from the old village, this counter is open to you.
annette.dialogue.Introduction: Hello, @. I'm Annette, Prefect of Moon Village. If the roads feel strange here, don't worry... some of them are still remembering how to be roads. $1
annette.dialogue.Mon: Some mornings I still expect the village bell to be frozen in the air. Then I hear birdsong, and I remember we are awake. $1
annette.dialogue.Tue: The sun is shining beautifully today! I hope you're taking care of yourself, @. Work can wait sometimes. $1
annette.dialogue.Wed: I love walking around town on Wednesdays. Have you been to the lake? Kira loves the breeze there. $1
annette.dialogue.Thu: The Townhall feels warmer now. Not fixed, exactly... but alive enough to remember us. $0
annette.dialogue.Fri: Fridays feel special. Are you going to the saloon tonight, @? Don't stay out too late if you're tired. $0
annette.dialogue.Sat: Saturday is my day off. I like to slow down and spend time with my dog, Kira. $1
annette.dialogue.Sun: Sundays are for resting. A quiet Sunday can heal your spirit more than you realize. $1
annette.dialogue.Mon8: Happy Monday, @. It is a busy week. I spent the morning listening to Lorilai and Venessa argue about medicine. My head is spinning! $2
annette.dialogue.Wed10: Kira and I just came back from the lake. Venessa says the lake is 'messy,' and Lorilai says it is 'pure.' I think it is just a nice place for a dog to swim! $1
annette.dialogue.Fri12: Heading to the saloon? I hope it is quiet. Some evenings the village still feels a little too full of old echoes. $0
annette.dialogue.Tue16: The sun is strong today. I have a headache from paperwork. I may ask Lorilai for tea, or Venessa for one of her moonstone compresses. $2
annette.dialogue.Thu18: It is very quiet today. I tried Lorilai's herbal tea this morning, and for once the old Townhall did not feel so cold. $1
annette.dialogue.Sun21: Sundays are for resting. Even Kira is tired of the drama in town lately. We are just going to stay home. $1
annette.dialogue.rain: I hope you have your boots on, @! It's wet today. I like the sound of the rain; it makes the house feel warm. $1
annette.dialogue.GreenRain: What is all this green fluff?! Please be careful, @. Kira is very scared of it. $3
annette.dialogue.spring_Mon: Spring is beautiful! Can you smell the flowers? It makes our morning walks so lovely. $1
annette.dialogue.summer_Wed: It’s so hot today. Drink plenty of water while you work. I have an extra bottle for me and Kira. $0
annette.dialogue.fall_Fri: The leaves are changing color. Autumn might be my favorite season. $1
annette.dialogue.winter_Sun: Brrr... it's freezing! Go home and sit by the fire, @. Even Kira prefers the rug over the snow today. $3
annette.dialogue.Saloon: Ah, it is good to be off work! I love seeing the village together. I just wish the two elves would stop whispering about each other. $0
annette.dialogue.Mountain: Kira is having so much fun! She almost chased a squirrel into Lorilai’s herb basket. I had to apologize for ten minutes! $1
annette.dialogue.Forest: The trees here know more than they say. Sometimes I think they were guarding Moon Village all along. $1
annette.dialogue.Town: Being Prefect is a big job when your two healers won't even sit at the same table! $2
annette.dialogue.Hearts_2: It’s lovely talking to you, @. I feel like we’re becoming good friends. $1
annette.dialogue.Hearts_4: You’re one of the kindest people in the valley. It feels safe having you here. $1
annette.dialogue.Hearts_6: When the curse held us, I dreamed of footsteps on old roads. I think they were yours, @. $1
annette.dialogue.Hearts_8: I was afraid the village would wake and find itself empty. But you helped bring voices back to the streets. $3
annette.dialogue.Hearts_10: Thank you for always being there. You’re my very best friend in the whole valley. $1
annette.dialogue.AcceptGift_Loved: Oh, I love this! Thank you so much, @! $1
annette.dialogue.AcceptGift_Liked: A gift for me? That’s so sweet, thank you! $1
annette.dialogue.AcceptGift_Neutral: Thank you, this is very nice. $1
annette.dialogue.AcceptGift_Disliked: Erm... thank you, I guess. But this isn't really my thing. $2
annette.dialogue.AcceptGift_Hated: Why would you give me this? I really don't like it. $5
annette.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)724: Maple syrup! Oh, thank you so much, this is fantastic! $1
annette.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)72: A Diamond!! It's stunning! Are you sure you can afford to give this away? $4
annette.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)80: Quartz? It's beautiful... I'll keep this somewhere safe! $1
annette.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)233: Oh! Ice Cream! This was exactly what I needed. $1
annette.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)152: Seaweed? Erm... thanks, I guess. I'm not sure what to do with it. $3
annette.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)167: Joja Cola? No thank you. It's just sugar and chemicals. $5
annette.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)StardropT: Oh, Stardrop Tea... it's my favorite. You really shouldn't spoil me like this! $1
annette.dialogue.AcceptBirthdayGift_Love: You remembered my birthday? That is incredibly kind. Thank you! $1
annette.dialogue.AcceptBirthdayGift_Like: A birthday present? That was very thoughtful. Thank you, @. $1
annette.dialogue.FlowerDance_Accept: Yes, I'd love to dance with you, @! $1
annette.dialogue.FlowerDance_Decline: That’s very sweet, but I’m afraid I have to say no today. $2
annette.dialogue.Dumped_Girls: I thought we had something special, @. I guess I was wrong. $2
annette.dialogue.Divorce: I don't want to talk right now. Please leave me alone. $5
kira.dialogue.Introduction: Woof! *wags tail eagerly* Hi! I'm Kira. Have you seen my human, Annette, anywhere? She's the best person in the whole world!
kira.dialogue.Mon: Woof! Today I'm following Annette to the mountains. I'll make sure no scary slimes get anywhere near her!
kira.dialogue.Tue: Did I hear the word... WALK?! *jumps up and down* Annette is so nice to take me out around town.
kira.dialogue.Wed: The sun is shining and I smell... fish! I hope Annette lets me have a tiny bite if she catches anything!
kira.dialogue.Thu: Annette is working so hard in the cellar. I'm lying right outside the door to keep watch so she feels safe.
kira.dialogue.Fri: The forest is full of exciting smells! But I'm staying close to Annette; I don't want her getting lost without me.
kira.dialogue.Sat: There are so many people in town today. I'm going to sit nicely and be a very good girl for Annette's sake.
kira.dialogue.Sun: A quiet day... Annette scratched me behind the ears this morning. It was the best moment of my life! *happy panting*
kira.dialogue.Rainy: Bleh, it's raining outside. But that's okay, as long as I get to lie on the rug by Annette's feet and dry off.
kira.dialogue.GreenRain: Why is the sky green?! *low whimpering* I'm staying right here by Annette's side. I'll protect you, Mom!
kira.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)68: WOOF! A meatball?! You're almost as nice as Annette! Thank you!
kira.dialogue.AcceptGift_Generic: *happy woof* Thank you so much! I'm gonna show this to Annette later!
kira.dialogue.RejectGift_Generic: *sniff sniff* ...No thanks, I can't eat that. Don't you have a bone instead?
lorilai.dialogue.Introduction: Hello! You must be @. I'm Lorilai, the village herbalist. If you ever feel sick or need help with plants, come see me. Moon Village soil remembers more than people think. $1
lorilai.dialogue.Mon: Mondays are good for cutting fresh stems. Plants wake slowly, just like people do. $1
lorilai.dialogue.Tue: The sun is so bright today! It is good for the herbs. I hope you are taking care of yourself too, @. Work can wait sometimes. $1
lorilai.dialogue.Wed: I love walking by the lake on Wednesdays to look for moss. Have you been there lately? Annette says Kira loves the cool breeze by the water. $1
lorilai.dialogue.Thu: The weekend is almost here. Moonvillage is very quiet today. I think these are the days when people need a little extra kindness. $0
lorilai.dialogue.Fri: Fridays feel special, don't they? Are you going to the saloon tonight, @? If you feel tired, try some herbal tea instead of staying out too late. $0
lorilai.dialogue.Sat: Saturday is my day off. I like to walk in the woods and enjoy the trees. It is much better than being busy all the time. $1
lorilai.dialogue.Sun: Sundays are for resting. Just like the soil needs to rest in winter, our spirits need a quiet day to heal. $1
lorilai.dialogue.Mon8: A new week! The dirt feels warm today. Venessa probably hates that I get my hands dirty, but the best medicine comes from the ground, not a shiny rock. $1
lorilai.dialogue.Wed10: I found some rare berries by the lake today. Annette’s dog, Kira, tried to eat them! I told Annette they were for medicine. Venessa would probably just try to 'wish' the pain away. $2
lorilai.dialogue.Fri12: If you go to the saloon, enjoy yourself! But don't listen to Venessa if she tells you to drink her 'magic water.' My ginger tea is much better for your stomach. $1
lorilai.dialogue.Tue16: The birds are singing so loudly! They know where the best herbs grow. Venessa stays inside with her books too much. She misses the real magic of the forest. $1
lorilai.dialogue.Thu18: It is a peaceful day. I am making a new cream for sore muscles. I offered some to Annette, but Venessa rolled her eyes at me. She is so stiff! $2
lorilai.dialogue.Sun21: I am spending my Sunday listening to the trees. They have more patience than most people in town. $1
lorilai.dialogue.rain: The plants are so happy for this rain! It is a bit wet for a walk, though. I love the sound of the water on my roof while I dry my herbs. $1
lorilai.dialogue.GreenRain: This green rain is old forest magic. Not bad, I think... but wild. Wash your hands before eating anything today. $3
lorilai.dialogue.spring_Mon: Spring is here! The air smells like sweet flowers. It makes my morning walks in Moon Village so lovely. $1
lorilai.dialogue.summer_Wed: It is very hot today. Please drink plenty of water while you work on the farm. I always carry an extra bottle for myself. $0
lorilai.dialogue.fall_Fri: The leaves are turning red and gold. Autumn is the best time to gather roots and berries. $1
lorilai.dialogue.winter_Sun: It is so cold! Go home and stay warm by the fire, @. Even Kira is staying inside on her rug today. $3
lorilai.dialogue.Saloon: The food here is okay, but it needs more fresh herbs. I tried to give the cook some wild parsley, but Venessa told him it looked 'suspicious.' She has no taste! $2
lorilai.dialogue.Mountain: Do you see that moss by the water? It is perfect for making healing bandages. Venessa thinks magic rocks are better, but nature provides everything we need. $1
lorilai.dialogue.Forest: This is where the best medicine grows. Not the strongest medicine, maybe... but the kind that forgives you for needing it. $1
lorilai.dialogue.ScienceHouse: I come here to talk to Robin sometimes. She understands the value of good wood. Unlike the 'Doctor,' who only cares about things that sparkle. $2
lorilai.dialogue.Hearts_2: It is nice to talk to you, @. I think we are becoming good friends. $1
lorilai.dialogue.Hearts_4: You are a very kind person. Moon Village feels safer with you here. $1
lorilai.dialogue.Hearts_6: I am so happy you moved here. Our village felt a bit empty before. You make this place feel like a real home. $1
lorilai.dialogue.Hearts_8: You know, @... I really trust you. My heart feels at peace when we talk. $3
lorilai.dialogue.Hearts_10: Thank you for being such a wonderful friend. You are the person I care about most in this whole valley. $1
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptGift_Loved: Oh, I love this! It is a wonderful gift. Thank you so much, @! $1
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptGift_Liked: A gift for me? That is so sweet of you. Thank you! $1
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptGift_Neutral: Thank you. This is very nice of you to give. $1
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptGift_Disliked: Oh... thank you, I guess. But this is not really something I like. $2
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptGift_Hated: Why would you give me this? It does not feel right at all. $5
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)724: Maple syrup! It comes straight from the trees. Thank you, this is amazing! $1
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)72: A Diamond! It is so bright and beautiful. Are you sure you want to give this to me? $4
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)80: Quartz. Clean, quiet, and honest. A good stone for steady hands. $1
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)233: Oh! Ice Cream! This is a very sweet treat. It is exactly what I needed today. $1
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)152: Seaweed? I am not sure what to do with this. It smells a bit strange. $3
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)167: Joja Cola? No thank you. I only like natural things. This is just sugar and chemicals. $5
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)StardropT: Stardrop Tea... it is my favorite thing in the world. You are so kind to me. $1
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptBirthdayGift_Love: You remembered my birthday? That makes me so happy, @. Thank you! $1
lorilai.dialogue.AcceptBirthdayGift_Like: A birthday present? That was very kind of you to think of me. $1
lorilai.dialogue.FlowerDance_Accept: I would love to dance with you! Let's go. $1
lorilai.dialogue.FlowerDance_Decline: That is very sweet, but I am too shy to dance today. I'm sorry. $2
lorilai.dialogue.Dumped_Girls: I thought we had something special. I feel very sad that I was wrong. $2
lorilai.dialogue.Divorce: I do not want to talk right now. Please leave me alone with my plants. $5
venessa.dialogue.Introduction: Greetings. You must be @. I am Venessa, the village healer. I work with moonstones, clean water, and careful spellwork. $1
venessa.dialogue.Mon: Mondays are for new growth. Take it slow, @. Even the oldest trees started as small seeds. $1
venessa.dialogue.Tue: The sun is very bright. It helps my healing crystals glow. Please do not work too hard; your body needs rest just like the soil. $1
venessa.dialogue.Wed: I saw Annette and Kira by the lake today. Kira was splashing around, making a mess. It is hard to find quiet spots for meditation lately. $2
venessa.dialogue.Thu: The village is quiet today. Quiet is useful. It lets me hear when the crystals begin to sing. $0
venessa.dialogue.Fri: It is Friday. Are you going to the saloon tonight, @? If you get a headache, come to me. Do not let Lorilai give you one of her strange 'root drinks.' $1
venessa.dialogue.Sat: Saturday is my time to connect with the forest. The trees have lived much longer than anyone in Moon Village. They have many secrets. $1
venessa.dialogue.Sun: Sunday is for peace. Let your spirit heal today. Even the stars rest during the day, and so should you. $1
venessa.dialogue.Mon8: It is the second week of the season. I hope you are staying healthy, @. I had to fix a mess Lorilai made yesterday. She tried to heal a scratch with moss! Magic is much cleaner. $2
venessa.dialogue.Wed10: I saw Annette and Kira by the river. Annette looks stressed. She spends too much time listening to the herbalist's 'natural advice.' She needs real healing. $0
venessa.dialogue.Fri12: Are you going to the saloon tonight? If you see Lorilai, tell her that my crystals are glowing brighter than her flowers today. She will know what it means. $2
venessa.dialogue.Tue16: The moon is in a good position for my spells today. My magic feels very strong. Lorilai probably doesn't even feel the moon's power. She is too busy looking at the dirt. $1
venessa.dialogue.Thu18: Moon Village is so quiet. It is a good time for me to study my ancient books. Lorilai thinks you can learn everything from a leaf. She is very wrong. $0
venessa.dialogue.Sun21: Sunday is a day for high spirits. I will spend my day cleaning my clinic. It must be perfect. Unlike Lorilai’s house... it smells like wet grass in there. $2
venessa.dialogue.rain: The rain cleans the air and the soul. I enjoy staying inside to polish my healing gems while the water falls. $1
venessa.dialogue.GreenRain: This green rain carries old life-energy. Fascinating... but please do not stand in it too long. $3
venessa.dialogue.spring_Mon: Spring has returned! The magic in the air is very strong. It makes my morning walks so refreshing. $1
venessa.dialogue.summer_Wed: The heat is intense. Drink plenty of water, @. I had to give Annette a cooling potion today because she was working too much. $0
venessa.dialogue.fall_Fri: The leaves are falling. It is a beautiful cycle of life. A good time to gather energy before the frost. $1
venessa.dialogue.winter_Sun: It is so cold. Please stay warm by your fire. I saw Kira wearing a tiny coat today... Annette cares for that dog very much. $3
venessa.dialogue.Saloon: It is quite loud in here, isn't it? I prefer the quiet hum of my healing crystals. I saw Lorilai earlier... she has dirt under her fingernails even at dinner. $2
venessa.dialogue.Mountain: The lake is beautiful, but the damp air is not good for my hair. I am only here because Annette said the fresh air would do me good. $0
venessa.dialogue.Forest: The forest magic here is powerful, but untidy. Lorilai calls that natural. I call it difficult to measure. $2
venessa.dialogue.Hospital: Welcome to my clinic. Please try not to bring any mud inside. I just finished cleaning the floors with a purifying spell. $1
venessa.dialogue.Hearts_2: It is nice to talk to you, @. I think we are becoming good friends. $1
venessa.dialogue.Hearts_4: You have a kind heart. Moon Village feels more alive with you here. $1
venessa.dialogue.Hearts_6: I am glad you moved here. I usually prefer the company of trees, but I like talking to you. $1
venessa.dialogue.Hearts_8: I trust you, @. My heart feels very peaceful when you are nearby. $3
venessa.dialogue.Hearts_10: You are my favorite person in this valley. Thank you for being such a wonderful friend to me. $1
venessa.dialogue.AcceptGift_Loved: This is wonderful! It has such a pure energy. Thank you so much, @! $1
venessa.dialogue.AcceptGift_Liked: A gift? How thoughtful of you. I will cherish this. $1
venessa.dialogue.AcceptGift_Neutral: Thank you. This is a kind gesture. $1
venessa.dialogue.AcceptGift_Disliked: Oh... thank you, I suppose. But this does not fit my tastes. $2
venessa.dialogue.AcceptGift_Hated: This carries the wrong kind of energy. Please keep it away from my clinic. $5
venessa.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)724: Maple syrup! A sweet gift from the trees. This is lovely, thank you! $1
venessa.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)72: A Diamond. Clear, focused, and full of stored light. This is an excellent healing stone. $4
venessa.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)80: Quartz. It is very useful for my healing work. I will use it well. $1
venessa.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)233: Ice cream? It is very cold and sweet! A perfect treat for a busy Healer. $1
venessa.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)152: Seaweed? It smells like salt and decay. I have no use for this. $3
venessa.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)167: Joja Cola? Absolutely not. It is full of artificial chemicals. My body is a temple. $5
venessa.dialogue.AcceptGift_(O)StardropT: Stardrop Tea... the most magical drink of all. You are too kind to me. $1
venessa.dialogue.AcceptBirthdayGift_Love: You remembered my birthday? That makes me very happy, @. Thank you! $1
venessa.dialogue.AcceptBirthdayGift_Like: A birthday present? You are very sweet to think of me. $1
venessa.dialogue.FlowerDance_Accept: I would love to dance with you. Let us move gently, like moonlight on water. $1
venessa.dialogue.FlowerDance_Decline: I am sorry, @. I am feeling a bit too shy to dance today. $2
venessa.dialogue.Dumped_Girls: I thought we shared a special bond. It seems my heart was mistaken. $2
venessa.dialogue.Divorce: Please leave. I need to be alone with my magic and my thoughts. $5
annette.progress.annette_house.mon: The Townhall feels different now. I can hear the old boards settling, almost like the building is remembering how to breathe. $1
annette.progress.annette_house.tue: Lorilai keeps asking questions about what year it is. I answer gently, but I think the truth hurts more each time. $2
annette.progress.hidden_maze.fri: The maze is stirring again. If the moon-gate opens for you, listen to the woods before you trust the path. $2
annette.progress.final.sun: Moonvillage is not the same village I lost, but maybe that is all right. It is alive, and that is more than I dared hope for. $1
annette.progress.final.hearts8: You did more than repair buildings, @. You gave us mornings, arguments, warm windows, and ordinary days. I will never forget that. $1
kira.progress.annette_house.wed: The house smells less sad now! Annette still worries, but her footsteps sound lighter. I like that sound. *happy wag*
kira.progress.hidden_maze.thu: *quiet whine* The path near the moon-gate smells wrong today. Like wet leaves, old metal, and something pretending to sleep.
kira.progress.final.sat: Moonvillage smells busy again! Bread, tea, dust, people, flowers... and Annette laughing. That one is my favorite smell.
lorilai.progress.annette_house.mon: I keep reaching for jars that are not where I left them. Then I remember how long the village slept, and my hands start shaking. $2
lorilai.progress.annette_house.tue: Annette says the village needs patience. I say it needs tea first, patience second. Thankfully, I can provide both. $1
lorilai.progress.herbalist.wed: My herbs are waking faster than I expected. Moss has already crept into the window frame. I missed that stubborn little plant. $1
lorilai.progress.herbalist.thu: Do not tell Venessa, but I found one of her old crystal labels tucked inside my herb journal. We must have worked together once. $2
lorilai.progress.grocery.fri: The grocery shelves are standing again. It feels silly, but seeing bread and tea for sale makes the curse feel smaller. $1
lorilai.progress.final.sun: I still think Venessa polishes her crystals too much, but... her wards helped the new seedlings survive. Do not tell her I said that. $1
venessa.progress.spirit_healer.mon: My clinic hums again. The crystals woke before I touched them, as if they had been waiting for permission to sing. $1
venessa.progress.spirit_healer.thu: Lorilai brought herbs to the clinic this morning. I was prepared to object, but some of them harmonize with moon quartz beautifully. Annoying, but useful. $2
venessa.progress.hidden_maze.tue: The maze does not simply change paths. It rearranges intent. Step into it with fear and it will answer in kind. $2
venessa.progress.final.sun: The village is noisy again. I thought I wanted silence, but the sound of people living is... tolerable. Pleasant, even. $1
venessa.progress.final.hearts8: You have seen Moon Village broken and whole, @. That makes you part of its record now. I will write your name carefully. $1
npcquestion.annette.first_moonvillage.qu: What was Moonvillage like before it disappeared?
npcquestion.annette.first_moonvillage.an: It was quieter than Pelican Town, but not lonely. The paths glowed at night, the granary bell marked the seasons, and every house kept a lantern ready in case the woods shifted.
npcquestion.annette.hidden_maze.question: Why does the hidden maze worry you?
npcquestion.annette.hidden_maze.answer: The maze was built to confuse things that should not find the village. When its paths change too quickly, it usually means something inside is awake and testing the walls.
npcquestion.annette.moon_dungeon.answer: An old stair, older than the house itself. My family guarded it because the moon crystals below remember every footstep, even the ones made by monsters.
npcquestion.annette.lanterns.question: Why are lanterns so important here?
npcquestion.annette.lanterns.answer: Moon Village lanterns are not just for light. They tell travelers which roads are honest. If a lantern burns blue, you can trust the path beneath it.
npcquestion.kira.lantern_work.question: How do Moon Village lanterns work?
npcquestion.kira.lantern_work.answer: The glass is ordinary, mostly. The trick is the resin. It catches moonlight like dew, then remembers it. That is why they glow even when the sky is covered.
npcquestion.kira.path_marks.question: What do the marks on the paths mean?
npcquestion.kira.path_marks.answer: Three lines means safe road. A crescent means watch your shadow. A broken circle means turn around unless someone from the village walks with you.
npcquestion.kira.fear.question: Are you afraid of the maze?
npcquestion.kira.fear.answer: Yes. But fear is useful if you listen before it starts shouting. The maze has a sound when it is hungry for visitors. I try not to ignore it.
npcquestion.lorilai.herbs.question: What makes Moon Village herbs different?
npcquestion.lorilai.herbs.answer: They grow with one root in the valley and one root in memory. Pick them too quickly and they taste like grass. Wait for moon dew and they become medicine.
npcquestion.lorilai.spirit_healer.questi: What does a spirit healer do?
npcquestion.lorilai.spirit_healer.answer: I do not command spirits. I listen for what still aches after a place is repaired. Sometimes a house needs nails. Sometimes it needs someone to remember who laughed there.
npcquestion.lorilai.moon_tea.question: Why does your tea feel magical?
npcquestion.lorilai.moon_tea.answer: Because tea is already magic. Hot water teaches leaves to speak. Moon Village leaves just happen to speak a little louder.
npcquestion.venessa.crystals.question: What are moon crystals?
npcquestion.venessa.crystals.answer: They are not gems exactly. They grow where light, stone, and old promises press together for long enough. Break one and it sings. Listen closely and it sounds like a warning.
npcquestion.venessa.records.question: Why do you keep so many records?
npcquestion.venessa.records.answer: Because Moon Village vanished once. Stories soften when people are scared, but ink stays stubborn. If something happens again, I want the next person to start with facts.
npcquestion.venessa.boss_rumor.question: Have you seen the creature in the maze?
npcquestion.venessa.boss_rumor.answer: Only its outline. Too tall, too still, and bright at the edges like moonlight caught on a blade. If you go looking for it, bring something stronger than curiosity.
